criteria.label: Specific viewer
criteria.question: Can you name the person (their job or situation), not just "everyone interested in AI"?

criteria.label: Real problem
criteria.question: Is this a pain the viewer already has or already searches for?

criteria.label: Concrete outcome
criteria.question: After watching, can they do or decide something specific they could not before?

criteria.label: Proof

criteria.label: Take-away and next step
